sentences.text_target: Tom wakes up in his bed.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm weɪks ʌp ɪn hɪz bɛd/
sentences.text_native: Tom se réveille dans son lit.

sentences.text_target: He feels very sick today.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fiːlz ˈvɛri sɪk təˈdeɪ/
sentences.text_native: Il se sent très malade aujourd'hui.

sentences.text_target: He has a bad headache and a fever.
sentences.phonetic: /hi hæz ə bæd ˈhɛdˌeɪk ænd ə ˈfiːvə/
sentences.text_native: Il a un affreux mal de tête et de la fièvre.

sentences.text_target: Tom takes the thermometer to check his temperature.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm teɪks ðə θəˈmɒmɪtə tu tʃɛk hɪz ˈtɛmprɪtʃə/
sentences.text_native: Tom prend le thermomètre pour vérifier sa température.

sentences.text_target: The doctor is not here.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈdɒktə ɪz nɒt hɪə/
sentences.text_native: Le médecin n'est pas là.

sentences.text_target: He needs to go to the pharmacy.
sentences.phonetic: /hi niːdz tu gəʊ tu ðə ˈfɑːməsi/
sentences.text_native: Il doit aller à la pharmacie.

sentences.text_target: Tom walks to the local pharmacy near his house.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm wɔːks tu ðə ˈləʊkəl ˈfɑːməsi nɪə hɪz haʊs/
sentences.text_native: Tom se rend à pied à la pharmacie du quartier près de chez lui.

sentences.text_target: The pharmacist gives him a box of medicine.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑːməsɪst gɪvz hɪm ə bɒks ɒv ˈmɛdsɪn/
sentences.text_native: Le pharmacien lui donne une boîte de médicaments.

sentences.text_target: Tom returns to his kitchen.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm rɪˈtɜːnz tu hɪz ˈkɪtʃɪn/
sentences.text_native: Tom retourne dans sa cuisine.

sentences.text_target: He puts the box on the kitchen counter.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts ðə bɒks ɒn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈkaʊntə/
sentences.text_native: Il pose la boîte sur le plan de travail de la cuisine.

sentences.text_target: He opens the package carefully.
sentences.phonetic: /hi ˈəʊpənz ðə ˈpækɪdʒ ˈkeəfʊli/
sentences.text_native: Il ouvre l'emballage avec précaution.

sentences.text_target: There is a bottle and a small spoon inside.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈbɒtl ænd ə smɔːl spuːn ɪnˈsaɪd/
sentences.text_native: Il y a une bouteille et une petite cuillère à l'intérieur.

sentences.text_target: He sees a tablet and reads the label.
sentences.phonetic: /hi siːz ə ˈtæblɪt ænd riːdz ðə ˈleɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il voit un comprimé et lit l'étiquette.

sentences.text_target: The instructions explain the posology.
sentences.phonetic: /ði ɪnˈstrʌkʃənz ɪksˈpleɪn ðə pəˈsɒlədʒi/
sentences.text_native: La notice explique la posologie.

sentences.text_target: He must take one pill in the morning.
sentences.phonetic: /hi mʌst teɪk wʌn pɪl ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/
sentences.text_native: Il doit prendre un comprimé le matin.

sentences.text_target: He needs another dose at night.
sentences.phonetic: /hi niːdz əˈnʌðə dəʊs æt naɪt/
sentences.text_native: Il a besoin d'une autre dose le soir.

sentences.text_target: The correct dose is important for his health.
sentences.phonetic: /ðə kəˈrɛkt dəʊs ɪz ɪmˈpɔːtənt fɔː hɪz hɛlθ/
sentences.text_native: La bonne posologie est importante pour sa santé.

sentences.text_target: He fills a glass with fresh water.
sentences.phonetic: /hi fɪlz ə glɑːs wɪð frɛʃ ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Il remplit un verre d'eau fraîche.

sentences.text_target: Tom swallows the pill with the water.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈswɒləʊz ðə pɪl wɪð ðə ˈwɔːtə/
sentences.text_native: Tom avale le comprimé avec l'eau.

sentences.text_target: He waits a little time in the kitchen.
sentences.phonetic: /hi weɪts ə ˈlɪtl taɪm ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/
sentences.text_native: Il patiente un moment dans la cuisine.

sentences.text_target: His stomach feels a bit strange after the food.
sentences.phonetic: /hɪz ˈstʌmək fiːlz ə bɪt streɪndʒ ˈɑːftə ðə fuːd/
sentences.text_native: Son estomac se sent un peu bizarre après avoir mangé.

sentences.text_target: He walks slowly to the living room.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɔːks ˈsləʊli tu ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ ruːm/
sentences.text_native: Il marche lentement vers le salon.

sentences.text_target: There is a comfortable sofa near the table.
sentences.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə ˈkʌmfətəbl ˈsəʊfə nɪə ðə ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il y a un canapé confortable près de la table.

sentences.text_target: Tom lies down on the sofa.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm laɪz daʊn ɒn ðə ˈsəʊfə/
sentences.text_native: Tom s'allonge sur le canapé.

sentences.text_target: He puts a warm blanket over his legs.
sentences.phonetic: /hi pʊts ə wɔːm ˈblæŋkɪt ˈəʊvə hɪz lɛgz/
sentences.text_native: Il pose une couverture chaude sur ses jambes.

sentences.text_target: He leaves his phone on the small table.
sentences.phonetic: /hi liːvz hɪz fəʊn ɒn ðə smɔːl ˈteɪbl/
sentences.text_native: Il laisse son téléphone sur la petite table.

sentences.text_target: He needs to rest for several hours.
sentences.phonetic: /hi niːdz tu rɛst fɔː ˈsɛvrəl ˈaʊəz/
sentences.text_native: Il a besoin de se reposer pendant plusieurs heures.

sentences.text_target: Tom closes his eyes and tries to sleep.
sentences.phonetic: /tɒm ˈkləʊzɪz hɪz aɪz ænd traɪz tu sliːp/
sentences.text_native: Tom ferme les yeux et essaie de dormir.

sentences.text_target: Good rest helps his fast recovery.
sentences.phonetic: /gʊd rɛst hɛlps hɪz fɑːst rɪˈkʌvəri/
sentences.text_native: Un bon repos l'aide à guérir rapidement.

sentences.text_target: He will feel much better tomorrow.
sentences.phonetic: /hi wɪl fiːl mʌtʃ ˈbɛtə təˈmɒrəʊ/
sentences.text_native: Il se sentira beaucoup mieux demain.
